content.title: Plan E2E isolation hardening
content.description:
Plan the implementation of the accepted hardening design (review mqh1ghz42s). Read that review in full — it is the spec. Then plan the concrete implementation of all three layers:

Layer A: Extend packages/webapp/server/routes/health.ts (or add a test-only route e.g. api/debug/cwd) to echo the resolved tracker cwd. In packages/webapp/e2e/global-setup.ts, after ensureE2EWorktree + resetWorktreeData, GET that endpoint and assert the returned path equals the e2e data dir (validation/.e2edata); throw a clear error on mismatch.

Layer B: Grep every spec under packages/webapp/e2e for seed-creation call sites (request.post to the api/issues route, or helpers wrapping it). Plan how each will tag issues with 'e2e-seed' and capture created ids. Plan a shared afterEach/afterAll in packages/webapp/e2e/setup.ts that lists issues tagged 'e2e-seed' and deletes them (tolerant of already-deleted ids).

Layer C: Plan the README section listing the invariants.

Document in a comment: exact files/locations to change, the health response shape (or debug route path), the list of spec files needing seed-tag changes, and the test strategy. Flag any complication the review did not anticipate. Invariants to preserve: do not rename AGENTRACK_CWD; do not add reuseExistingServer; keep ports 3001/5174 distinct from 3000/5173.

content.content:
Implementation plan for the three-layer E2E isolation hardening (spec = library-architect ACCEPT comment on mqh1ghz42s). All facts below verified against source on 2026-06-16.

=========================================================
LAYER A — Startup cwd assertion
=========================================================

GOAL: global-setup asserts the spawned backend resolves AGENTRACK_CWD to validation/.e2edata before any test runs.

DESIGN DECISION — how the backend exposes its cwd.
- server/utils/tracker.ts computes `const cwd = process.env.AGENTRACK_CWD || process.cwd()` at module load and passes it to `new Tracker(cwd)`. The Tracker class keeps `cwd` PRIVATE (packages/library/src/core/tracker.ts:209 `private cwd`), so the route cannot read it off the Tracker instance.
- Cleanest fix: export `cwd` from server/utils/tracker.ts (one line: `export const cwd = ...`) and have health.ts return it. This guarantees the value the Tracker actually used is the value we echo (no drift).

FILES / EXACT CHANGES:
1. packages/webapp/server/utils/tracker.ts — change `const cwd` to `export const cwd`.
2. packages/webapp/server/types.ts — extend HealthResponse:
     status: "ok"; tracker: "initialized" | "not_initialized"; cwd: string;
3. packages/webapp/server/routes/health.ts — import { tracker, cwd } and return { status, tracker, cwd }.
   - RESPONSE SHAPE: GET /api/health -> { "status": "ok", "tracker": "initialized", "cwd": "<absolute path>" }.
   - Exposing cwd is read-only diagnostic data; acceptable public API addition. The "gate behind a test-only env var" option is optional, not required.
4. packages/webapp/e2e/global-setup.ts — after ensureE2EWorktree() + resetWorktreeData(), poll GET /api/health on http://localhost:5001, assert body.cwd === getE2EDataDir(), throw a clear Error on mismatch. Retry loop (~10s grace). Becomes `export default async function globalSetup()`.

=========================================================
LAYER B — Self-healing tagged seeds
=========================================================

GOAL: every e2e-created issue is tagged e2e-seed and a teardown deletes all e2e-seed issues.

SPEC FILES NEEDING SEED-TAG CHANGES (full inventory, verified by grep):
- e2e/url-filters-validation.spec.ts — 1 wrapped helper seedIssues (lines 40-62). ONE edit (add tags to the make() payload at line 50). Covers all 15 call sites.
- e2e/phase2-validation.spec.ts — 24 inline request.post issue creates. Each needs tags.
- e2e/phase3-validation.spec.ts — ~90 inline issue creates (comment/blockage sub-route POSTs excluded). Each needs the tag.
- e2e/dashboard-roots-validation.spec.ts — 21 inline creates. Each needs the tag.
- e2e/phase1-validation.spec.ts — 0 creates. No change.
- e2e/phase4-validation.spec.ts — 0 issue creates (seeds users + sync; out of scope). No change.

TOTAL: ~136 inline edits + 1 helper edit. POST /api/issues already accepts tags (issues.ts:51), so no server change needed for tagging.

COMPLICATION THE REVIEW DID NOT ANTICIPATE — there is NO DELETE route on the webapp server. server/routes/issues.ts exposes GET/POST/GET:id/GET:next/GET:id/history/PATCH:id only. "Deletes them" cannot be done over HTTP today. Two options:
  (B1) Add a DELETE /api/issues/:id route (calls tracker.issueDelete(id) — already exposed by the library, used by the `agt delete` CLI). Small legitimate API addition. RECOMMENDED.
  (B2) Teardown shells out to `agt delete <id>` with AGENTRACK_CWD set (setup.ts already uses execSync; agt is on PATH). Avoids server change but couples tests to the CLI binary.

CLEANUP HELPER (recommended):
- Add cleanupE2ESeeds() to e2e/setup.ts: GET /api/issues?tags=e2e-seed, then DELETE each (tolerant of 404).
- Wire an afterAll(cleanupE2ESeeds) in each spec that creates seeds (url-filters, phase2, phase3, dashboard-roots). Playwright has no project-wide afterAll; per-spec afterAll is idiomatic and DRY via the shared helper.
- resetWorktreeData() already wipes e2edata at the START of every run (global-setup), so afterAll is belt-and-suspenders; it must tolerate already-deleted ids.

NOTE: resetWorktreeData runs ONCE per run, not per test, so tagged seeds accumulate within a run; per-spec afterAll keeps them scoped and makes the suite self-healing on aborted runs.

=========================================================
LAYER C — Documentation
=========================================================

GOAL: document the invariants so contributors do not break isolation.

COMPLICATION — there is NO README in packages/webapp/ at all (verified: no .md files; only root /README.md and /CLAUDE.md exist). The review says "add a section to the webapp e2e README". Options:
  (C1) Create packages/webapp/e2e/README.md with the invariants section. RECOMMENDED — colocated with specs/config.
  (C2) Add the section to the project root README.md.

CONTENT (invariants):
  1. Never start a dev server manually on the e2e backend port (5001) while tests run.
  2. Never set reuseExistingServer: true on either webServer entry in playwright.config.ts.
  3. The backend reads AGENTRACK_CWD to isolate data; global-setup asserts /api/health.cwd === validation/.e2edata and fails the run otherwise.
  4. Every spec must tag created issues with e2e-seed and call cleanupE2ESeeds() in afterAll.
  5. Ports are the isolation boundary and must stay distinct from production.

=========================================================
INVARIANTS TO PRESERVE (verified)
=========================================================
- AGENTRACK_CWD name is consistent (set in playwright.config.ts webServer.env, read in server/utils/tracker.ts). Do NOT rename.
- reuseExistingServer is ABSENT from both webServer entries. Do NOT add it.
- PORTS DISCREPANCY TO FLAG: the review/issue text references "3001/5174 distinct from 3000/5173", but the ACTUAL config uses 5001 (backend) and 5000 (frontend) for e2e, and server/index.ts defaults production to PORT 3000. Invariant (5) must state the REAL ports (5001/5000 e2e vs 3000 production), not the stale 3001/5174 numbers. Factual correction to the spec, not a code change.

=========================================================
OTHER COMPLICATIONS NOT ANTICIPATED BY THE REVIEW
=========================================================
1. No DELETE route on the server today (see Layer B). Any "delete the seeds" approach needs either a new route or a CLI shell-out. The review assumed HTTP delete was possible.
2. No webapp/e2e README exists; Layer C is a create, not an edit.
3. ~136 inline POSTs (no shared helper except in url-filters) makes the tagging change large and mechanical; a shared createSeedIssue() helper would reduce future drift but is a bigger refactor than the review assumed. Recommend inline tag additions now, optional helper refactor later.
4. Playwright has no global afterAll across files; cleanup must be wired per-spec (4 files).

=========================================================
TEST STRATEGY
=========================================================
- Layer A: temporarily aim the assertion at a wrong path and confirm the run fails fast with the clear error before any spec runs; revert. Then confirm a normal e2e run passes and /api/health returns the e2edata path.
- Layer B: run the full e2e suite, then GET /api/issues?tags=e2e-seed against the e2edata backend and confirm 0 remain; confirm nothing leaked into the REAL .agentrack/.
- Layer C: doc-only; no test.
- Regression: typecheck (npx tsc --noEmit), lint, and the existing e2e suite; ensure no flakes (workers:1 invariant preserved).

=========================================================
SUGGESTED IMPLEMENTATION ORDER (for the implementation child tasks)
=========================================================
1. Layer A (health cwd echo + global-setup assertion) — smallest, highest value, unblocks confident testing of B.
2. Add DELETE /api/issues/:id route (server) — prerequisite for B1.
3. Layer B tagging (url-filters first, then phase2, dashboard-roots, phase3) + cleanupE2ESeeds helper + per-spec afterAll.
4. Layer C README.
